title: karpenter-global-settings edits need a controller restart

detection.reason: matches a ConfigMap named karpenter-global-settings in any namespace

quote: Settings are no longer updated dynamically while Karpenter is running. If you manually make a change to the `karpenter-global-settings` ConfigMap, you will need to reload the containers by restarting the deployment with `kubectl rollout restart -n karpenter deploy/karpenter`
remediation: After editing karpenter-global-settings, restart the Karpenter deployment — the controller stops picking settings up while running. Plan a restart into any change window that touches this ConfigMap, and prefer moving the settings to container environment variables (which 0.33 makes mandatory anyway).
verifyCommand: kubectl get configmap -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "karpenter-global-settings") | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) keys=\((.data // {}) | keys | join(","))"'  # any row printed is a karpenter-global-settings ConfigMap that is still in place

title: aws.tags in karpenter-global-settings changes shape

detection.reason: the condition is the SHAPE of a ConfigMap VALUE (dotted aws.tags.<key> entries versus one JSON object), and ConfigMap data values are never collected — only the key names are

quote: `aws.tags` in `karpenter-global-settings` ConfigMap is now a top-level field and expects the value associated with this key to be a JSON object of string to string. This is change from previous versions where keys were given implicitly by providing the key-value pair `aws.tags.<key>: value` in the ConfigMap.
remediation: Rewrite the ConfigMap so `aws.tags` is a single key whose value is a JSON object of string to string, instead of one `aws.tags.<key>` entry per tag. Karpenter silently ignores settings it does not recognise, so the old form stops applying your tags without any error.
verifyCommand: kubectl get configmap -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "karpenter-global-settings") | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name + " " + ((.data // {}) | keys | map(select(startswith("aws.tags"))) | join(","))'  # a dotted aws.tags.something entry printed here is the old per-key shape, which stops applying after the upgrade
